title: Union Budget effective capital expenditure
definition: Direct capital expenditure by the Union Government plus grants-in-aid for creation of capital assets.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.title: Budget at a Glance 2026-2027

points.evidence: Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Effective Capital Expenditure (12+13)': FY 2024-25 (Actuals) is 1324609 crore INR.
Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Effective Capital Expenditure (12+13)': FY 2025-26 (Revised Estimates) is 1403906 crore INR.
points.estimate_method: Ministry of Finance Revised Estimates for FY 2025-26.

points.evidence: Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Effective Capital Expenditure (12+13)': FY 2026-27 (Budget Estimates) is 1714523 crore INR.
points.estimate_method: Ministry of Finance Budget Estimates for FY 2026-27.
